title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state that Bose-Einstein condensation does not occur for both two-dimensional and one-dimensional gases.

title: Reasoning for 2D
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must include reasoning about the divergence of the integral for the two-dimensional case when mu equals zero.

title: Reasoning for 1D
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must include reasoning about the divergence of the integral for the one-dimensional case when mu equals zero.

title: Understanding of mu
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate an understanding of the role of the chemical potential mu in Bose-Einstein condensation.

title: Mathematical Justification
description: Optional Criteria: Providing mathematical expressions or integrals to support the reasoning would enhance the response.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to mention that mu must be less than or equal to zero for condensation could lead to incorrect conclusions.
